blocks.text: Machine learning mechanisms (seekhne ke tareeqe) batate hain ke system data se kaise seekhta hai. Mukhtalif masloon ke liye mukhtalif tareeqe istemal hote hain. Kuch tareeqe labeled data istemal karte hain aur kuch nahi (Figure 6.4).

blocks.title: Labeled aur unlabeled data
blocks.text: Labeled data mein har cheez ke saath us ka sahi jawab (label) likha hota hai, jaise seb ki tasveer ke saath "Apple". Unlabeled data mein sirf cheezein hoti hain, jawab nahi; system ko khud groups dhoondne parte hain.

blocks.alt: Do tables saath saath. Baen taraf LABELED DATA (label wala data): columns Image aur Label, rows seb - Apple, kela - Banana, malta - Orange, angoor - Grapes; neeche: 'Used in supervised learning (e.g., classification, regression)'. Daen taraf UNLABELED DATA (baghair label ka data): 4 x 3 khanon mein yehi phal mili juli tarteeb se, koi label nahi; neeche: 'Used in unsupervised learning (e.g., clustering, association)'.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.4: Labeled aur unlabeled data (kitab ki Figure 6.4 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Baen taraf har tasveer ke saath us ka naam (label) likha hai; daen taraf tasveeron ke naam nahi diye gaye.

blocks.text: Kuch tareeqe feedback aur tajurbe se seekhte hain. Har mechanism ka seekhne ka apna tareeqa hai. Sahi mechanism chunna aham hai, kyunke seekhne ki quality isi par munhasir hai. Yeh mechanisms zaheen faisle karne mein madad dete hain, aur machine learning systems theek mechanism ke baghair achha kaam nahi karte. Neeche machine learning ki kuch qismein hain:
